in_hebrew.name: Jarlathus
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Jarlathus הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Jarlathus is derived from the Old Irish name 'O'Gallagáin' which means 'descendant of the valiant one'. The name Jarlathus is a variant of the name Galen, which means 'healer'. It is also believed to mean 'little ruler' or 'little chief'.
